metadata.name: React Next Vercel Webapp
metadata.description:
Overview: A Next.js App Router webapp with feature-sliced UI and thin server actions.
When to avoid: Avoid for pure static sites or systems whose backend domain logic belongs in a standalone service.
Layers: App routing, feature slices, UI components, shared libraries, and server-only dependencies.

rules.diagnostic: Application code crosses the feature public-entry boundary with a deep feature import.
rules.remediation: Export the dependency from the feature public entry and import that entry instead.

rules.diagnostic: A module imports the default server-only marker where the source ESLint policy forbids it.
rules.remediation: Remove the marker import or place server-only behavior behind an explicitly server-scoped module.
